26. 8. 18
Sinja Station.
August 24 th 191 8.
REPORT ON Premises 306 Great Western Road.
Made by Det.Insp.Fitzgibbon. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.

Sir,
Th.Rohn,a German,his Wife & two children
lived at 306 Great Western Road until about the 6 th October 191
when his family & himself removed to the Citizen School,Kiangwan
Road,& it is said they are still living there.
Above residence & grounds,the property of one R.Lundt,also a
German, a few weeks later were the subject of an action in the
Mixed Court at the instance of the Hongkong & Shanghai Banking
Corporation who had a Mortgage on the place which has not been
occupied by since Mr.Rohn left,a Chinese Watchman in the employ
of Messrs Lester Johnson & Morriss is looking after the premises.
The Bank having obtained judgment has been trying to sell this
property.

yours obediently,
En B. Maurice Fitzgibbon.
Det.Insp.
Chief Detective Inspector.

先生，
德国人 Th. Rohn 及其妻子和两个孩子
一直居住在大西路306号，直至191
年10月6日左右，
其家人及本人搬至江湾路的公民学校，
据说他们至今仍住在那里。
上述住宅及场地系另一德国人 R. Lundt 的财产，
数周后成为混合法庭诉讼的标的，
起诉方为拥有该处抵押权的汇丰银行，
自 Rohn 先生离开后，该处一直无人居住，
目前由 Lester Johnson & Morriss 公司雇佣的一名中国更夫看管。
银行在获得判决后，一直试图出售此房产。

您顺从的仆人，
En B. Maurice Fitzgibbon。

CENTRAL Station.
1st February, 1917.
REPORT ON Th. M. Rohn.
Made by D.S.I.Brewster. Forwarded by Chief Detective Inspector.
Sir,
Th. M. Rohn, who is a German, has lived with his wife and
children at No. 11 Great Western Road for several quite a few years.
He previously had an office at 38 Kiangse Road where he
imported piece goods, chemicals and drugs but the place was
closed down about a year ago. He now appears to be doing
some curio business among Chinese but is said to be in
financial difficulties. I am informed that his landlords,
the Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation have been
trying, without success so far, to get him ejected from his
house, a rather large one with grounds, for non-payment of
rent. He is about 45 years of age, rather short and stout,
has a round fat face, clean complexion, fair hair rather
bald on top, and fair moustache. He appears to be a very
quiet reserved sort of man and takes little interest in
anything beyond his business and his home.
Your obedient servant,
WBrewster.
Detective Sub-Inspector.
Chief Detective Inspector.
（批：AM 2/2）

先生，
德国人 Th. M. Rohn 与其妻子和
孩子在大西路11号已居住了好几年。
他此前在江西路38号设有办公室，
进口匹头、化学品和药品，但该处
约在一年前关闭。他现在似乎在与中国人
做一些古玩生意，但据称陷入
财务困境。我获悉，他的房东
汇丰银行一直试图将他逐出
其住宅（一所带场地的大房子），原因是欠租，
但至今未果。他约45岁，身材较矮且粗壮，
圆胖脸，肤色洁净，金发，头顶略秃，
留有金色胡须。他似乎是一个非常
安静、孤僻的人，除了生意和家庭外，
对其他事物鲜有兴趣。
您顺从的仆人，
W. Brewster。
副侦探督察。

Date 10. 5. 15

Shanghai Municipal Police

CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION DEPARTMENT.

Shanghai, 8th May 1915.

Confidential

Sir,

Arrangements are being made to have the man referred to in attached letter watched according to instructions.
The original request for information regarding him came from Sir Edward Fraser who it appears was instructed by the Home Authorities to the effect that a man who was stated to have come from Japan to Shanghai was a German Secret Service agent and should be shadowed. The name was not known but the Japanese Consul General through the agency of the Japanese Post Office here discovered that a Captain Blomeyer was receiving letters from Japan addressed to him at No.54 Avenue Dubail. It was then ascertained that Blomeyer had come from Yokohama where he had a residence but the Japanese Authorities there had no knowledge of his being a secret service agent.
The address was given to Mr. Kahn Consul General for France and he instructed the Police of the French Concession to have a watch kept on the movements of Blomeyer.
He is married to a Japanese who has now gone back to Japan, it is said, to sell some property which her husband owned at Yokohama.
A passport was applied for, on her behalf, by Mr. Sammons the U.S.Consul General. Mr. Ariyoshi refused to issue one and she presumably has gone without it.
His daily itinerary during the five months that he has been shadowed in the French Concession was not at all interesting. He visited the German School on the Avenue Paulun very frequently, the German Consulate almost everyday, was many times at the Hospital where his wife was for a long time on two occasions and spent the time when his wife was not with him in solitary walks.
In fact as far as the results of the surveillance by the French Police was concerned they might as well have shadowed any other German who lives in the French Concession.

All
Your Obedient Servant,
Chief Detective Inspector-
8/5.

Chief Detective Officer.

上海公共租界工部局警务处

刑事侦缉处。

上海，1915年5月8日。

机密

先生，

正按照指示安排对附信中提及之人进行监视。
最初关于此人的情报请求来自爱德华·弗雷泽爵士 (Sir Edward Fraser)，据悉他是奉本国当局之命行事，大意是有一名据称从日本来到上海的人是德国秘密情报人员，应予以跟踪。当时不知其姓名，但日本总领事通过此地日本邮局的渠道发现，一名 Blomeyer 上尉正在杜拜尔路 (Avenue Dubail) 54号接收来自日本的信件。随后查明，Blomeyer 来自横滨，他在那里有住所，但日本当局并不知晓他是秘密情报人员。
该地址已提供给法国总领事 Kahn 先生，他指令法租界巡捕房对 Blomeyer 的行踪进行监视。
他娶了一位日本妻子，据说她现已返回日本，去出售其丈夫在横滨拥有的某些财产。
美国总领事 Sammons 先生代其申请了护照。有吉明 (Ariyoshi) 拒绝签发，她大概是未持护照离境。
在他于法租界被监视的五个月期间，他的日常行程毫无趣味可言。他非常频繁地访问蒲石路 (Avenue Paulun) 的德国学校，几乎每天都去德国领事馆，多次前往医院，其妻子曾两次长期住院，而在妻子不陪伴时，他便独自散步。
事实上，就法国警察监视的结果而言，他们还不如去监视任何其他居住在法租界的德国人。

All
您顺从的仆人，
首席侦探督察-
8/5.

首席侦探官。

CONFIDENTIEL

Monsieur le Captain Superintendant,

J'ai l'honneur de vous informer qu'un sujet Allemand,
très connu des Consulats du Japon et d'Angleterre, nommé

du changement de résidence de Mr. BLOMEYER pour le cas où vous
croiriez devoir reprendre la surveillance que nous venons de
cesser du fait de son déplacement.

26th November 14

Sir,

Th M Röhn has an office at No 38 Kiangse Road. He is an importer of piece goods and of chemicals and drugs. Further enquiries are being made.

O Dopking who was referred to in the report of Nov 24th left for Woosung on the forenoon of the 25th. Mr Cassel suggests that his mission is to plant anti British sentiment in the minds of the students at the Naval college there. The house which he occupied is now vacant, the other gentleman having gone to the German Club.

Mr Cassel alleges that the Germans are conspiring with the members of the 'Koh Ming Tong' in Shanghai to create trouble in China but we have no information of this, neither have the French Intelligence Dept.

Your obedient servant

MA

C D O.                                Chief Detective Inspector.

先生，

Th M Röhn 在江西路38号设有办公室。他是匹头以及化学品和药品的进口商。正在进行进一步查询。

11月24日报告中提及的 O Dopking 于25日上午前往吴淞。Cassel 先生推测，他的任务是在那里海军学院的学生心中植入反英情绪。他所居住的房屋现已空置，另一位绅士已前往德国总会。

Cassel 先生声称，德国人正与上海的“光明团” (Koh Ming Tong) 成员勾结，意图在中国制造麻烦，但我们对此并无情报，法国情报部门也没有。

Made by D.S.I. Burnside Forwarded by ............................................................

Sir,
I have been informed that a German subject named
Hutton, supposed to be in some way or other connected
with Messrs Garlowitz, has been enabled to take out
American Citizenship papers at the U.S.S. Consulate
through the instrumentality of Mr. Blake of the
Standard Oil Co, and intends to proceed to Tsingtao
where, in some way or other, he expects to do damage.
Hutton, I am further informed, speaks English without
the least accent.

（批：Col.

S. M. POLICE.
C. I. D.
REGISTRY.
No. 2487
Date

Shanghai Municipal Police.
CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION DEPARTMENT.
14
Shanghai, 24th November 1914

Sir,
Mr Cassell British Secret Service Agent residing at the house of Mrs Limby in Jinkee Road informed Detective Inspector Eek on the 23rd that a German named O Dopking manager of A Wulfing & Co No 6 Kukiang Road and who resided at No 160 Bubbling Well Road, was formerly a German Secret Service agent in England, that he was sent out to China in connection with this same service and that his actions at the present time were not altogether without suspicion. Information was supplied by a Mr Norbrry the father of a young man employed with Wulfing & Co to the effect that Dopking kept always 2000 or 3000 dollars in ready money in the safe to provide against contingencies which were not likely to arise in the ordinary course of business, that he was at present intending going to Woosung, that he was searching for a suitable box or trunk to be taken to his house on Bubbling Well Road in which to store something (probably explosives). It was stated that he was living with two other Germans.
Inquiries were made by D S Sullivan who reported that the tenant of the house was originally a Mr F Ehrenfeld, an Assistant Sanitary Inspector in the employ of the Health Dept of the S M C, who being a reservist of the Austrian army left Shanghai and endeavoured to return to his country to rejoin the colours on the outbreak of the war but being unable to get further than America on the homeward journey he returned to Shanghai and resumed the work he had left. He is at present staying with a Mrs Rosenthal at No 164 Bubbling Well Road, is engaged to be married to the daughter of that lady and will return shortly to his former residence. D S Sullivan ascertained that Mr Dopking is packing up to go to the Woosung Hotel to-day (24th), that he had asked his boy to go along with him to that place and that the latter had declined. The Det Sgt also ascertained that there was another German in the house who was removing in the evening to the German Club. The name of the latter as given by the Chinese is Lamla (?). A third man at one time lived here also but he left about a month ago. His name has not yet been ascertained.
Your obedient servant

C D O.
Chief Detective Inspector.

上海，1914年11月24日

先生：

英国秘密情报局特工卡塞尔（Cassell）先生现居于静安寺路林比（Limby，音译）夫人寓所，他于23日向警探督察伊克（Eek，音译）通报称，德国人奥·多普金（O Dopking，音译）系九江路6号A. Wulfing & Co.公司的经理，居住于静安寺路160号，此人此前曾在英国担任德国秘密情报局特工，是受该机构派遣来华，且其目前的行踪并非毫无嫌疑。另有诺布里（Norbrry，音译）先生提供情报，其子受雇于Wulfing & Co.公司；据诺布里先生称，多普金常在保险箱内留存两三千美元现金，以备不时之需，而此类情况在正常商业活动中极不可能发生；多普金目前正打算前往吴淞，并正在寻找合适的箱子或皮箱，以便运至其静安寺路寓所内存放物品（可能是爆炸物）。据称，他与另外两名德国人同住。

警探沙利文（D S Sullivan）经查询后报告称，该房屋的租户原为F·埃伦费尔德（F Ehrenfeld，音译）先生，系工部局卫生处助理卫生督察员。作为奥地利陆军后备役人员，战争爆发时他离开上海，试图回国重新入伍，但在返程途中仅能抵达美国，无法继续前行，遂返回上海并恢复了此前离职的工作。他目前借住在静安寺路164号的罗森塔尔（Rosenthal，音译）夫人处，已与罗森塔尔夫人的女儿订婚，并将很快搬回原住所。警探沙利文查明，多普金先生正在整理行装，准备于今日（24日）前往吴淞饭店，他曾要求其男仆随行，但遭后者拒绝。该警佐还查明，屋内还有另一名德国人，将于当晚搬往德国总会。据华人提供的姓名，此人名叫拉姆拉（Lamla，音译，存疑）。此前还有一名男子在此居住，但约于一个月前离去。其姓名尚未查明。

您忠顺的仆人

C D O.
首席警探督察
